name: reply_to_toolbar_thread
description:
Post a reply, as the authenticated user, to an existing Vercel Toolbar comment thread. The reply is visible to everyone who can access the thread.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} comments reply {threadId} -m {message} --project {projectIdOrName}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

markdown.description: The message content in markdown format

teamId.description:
The ID or slug of the team that owns the resource.
Team IDs start with "team_".
If you do not know the team ID or slug, it can be found through these mechanism:
- Read the file .vercel/project.json if it exists and extract the orgId
- Use the `list_teams` tool

threadId.description: The thread ID to reply to
